nodes.asset_description: A minimalist still-life of a pour-over coffee setup: a dark metal funnel sits atop a small glass carafe half-filled with black coffee, with scattered beans beside it. Shot against a warm tan background, side lighting casts a clean, elongated shadow.

A glossy black dropper bottle with a gold collar and cream rubber pipette stands centered against a warm peach-orange background. The minimalist studio setup uses soft lighting, creating a gentle shadow and a clean, product-focused composition.

A hand holds a sleek white pump bottle against a warm beige background. The minimalist, product-style shot uses bright, direct light to cast a crisp shadow and emphasize clean lines and neutral tones.

A flat-lay of coffee-themed skincare products on a split peach and apricot background, featuring white and amber dropper bottles, a pump and squeeze tube, clear jars, and cups of coffee beans and espresso with scattered beans. The clean, minimalist composition uses warm browns, whites, and gold accents for a modern, high-contrast look.

A minimalist graphic shows a centered white diamond (a rotated square with slightly rounded corners) on a solid black background. The composition is symmetrical, high-contrast, and dominated by clean lines and negative space.
